stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Gone Fishing (Just Like Paradise) and play through Chapter 1 (Paradise Lost).

POINT OF NO RETURN: the morning after Down to Earth, do Lucia's balcony meditation — the only possibly-missable step in the game (see Positive Mental Attitude and the Missable watch view). Keep a manual save at the chapter start.
After Feng Shui, follow Cal's fishing quests (Baited My Tackle) and meet Kenton to start his 7-shipwreck treasure line (This Was No Boat Accident).
Play an arcade game on the home TV whenever you like (Stick Fiddler) — the first three games are there from Chapter 1.
Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go — the counts carry into the 100% checklist and save hours in stage 5.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — learn Leonida, do the one thing you cannot redo

stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Chapter 2 (T**s Ass Drug Money) with Breakfast Run, and push into Chapter 3 for The Cartel Heist.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2) you can switch characters and free-roam together — everything duo-shaped unlocks from here, and the final meditation spot needs both characters.

Start the named side lines as they open: Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub, after Coffee Break), Andy (Lucia-only, Chapter 3), Randy (after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — the Key Cloner from that mission also unlocks Capital Offense later), Tyrone (Jason-only, after Here, Kitty Kitty).
Do the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling and take all 3 valuables (Let's Go Bowling) — the icon respawns if you miss one, so this is a cleanup item, not a missable.
Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) for the Dye Pack Jammer: without it, marked bills cannot be laundered and stage 4 cannot start.
stages.title: Chapters 2–3 — Vice City opens up; start the side lines early

stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Chapters 4 and 5 (Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission — keep a manual save before the finale; there is no mission replay.

Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it unlocks bank-vault robberies, counts as the armored-truck robbery (A Classic Blitz Play), and vaults pay up to $205,000 each toward stage 4's laundering total.
Bank-vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level with your partner along, so Hot Together should pop on its own here; use the same heat for Retail Therapy's 3-shop streak.
After the credits, free-roam continues and the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats — stages 4 to 7 all live there.
stages.title: Chapters 4–5 — the finale; bank vaults open

stages.hours_note: estimate; mostly earned inside stages 2–3 robbery income
steps: Launder marked bills at fences (Yasmani pays most) until Dime on the Dollar's $250,000 total is reached — bank vaults from stage 3 are the richest source.
Spend $100,000 across all shops for Treat Yo Self: guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest sink, and the total is cumulative across every shop type.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app (Little Boxes, $160,000 total) — they unlock after Daily Driver in Chapter 2, so this can be finished as soon as the money exists.
Register 10 cheap vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (On the Spot) once the garages give you the parking spots; Moses in Port Gellhorn handles the paperwork.
stages.title: Money & property — launder, spend, buy, register

stages.hours_note: estimate; the core of PowerPyx's ~100 h Step 2
steps: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work the list: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts — plus in full: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, every shooting-range gold, all 42 drone races, all 15 Target Decks.

Grind order that saves time: unfog the map by plane first (The Goodtime State), then stunts (under-bridge flights are fastest; Cunning Stunts at 250, checklist wants 300), WAiNK scans (You WAiNKer! at 100), card sets (Don't Touch My Deck), drone races (finish all races at each of the 14 locations in one visit for Top Fun), shooting ranges (42 golds for The Shootist), races (20 wins for Earn Cash, Not Kudos), then challenges (One Last Thing at 50, checklist wants 70).
Master of None falls out of this stage on its own: one each of fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, a race win and a stunt.
Pest Control pops on the way to all 39 gang operations — one operation per gang is all the trophy itself asks.
A Long Road pops when the checklist is done; it is the hardest trophy in the set and usually the last big one before cleanup.
stages.title: The 100% grind — the checklist is the platinum

stages.hours_note: estimate; PowerPyx Step 3 is ~10 h, plus the feat hunting below
steps: Finish the counting stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; four more counting strands are still being found, so watch the trophy tracker after each strand (see the trophy's entry for the confirmed mission lists).
Work Bret's hunting line through (Fair Game): his 15 Target Decks are needed in full for stage 5's checklist anyway, so the two stages share the driving.

One-off feats, any order: Combat Focus x5 on gang enemies (Gunslinger), the VCIA jet at terminals E3/E4 (Catch Me If You Can), the Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station (Challenging Tank), the undetected jewelry robbery with the Snap Gun (Sneakthief), the blue Banshee through the showroom window (Capital Offense), max Strength for both characters training together (Personal Best), 500 Criminal Profile actions (Actions Speak Louder — usually already done).

NEW IN ROUND 3 — The Truth Is Out There is confirmed now: the UFO Easter egg on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, solo, at night after 2AM. Look for the blinking car, follow the path into the woods, and help the woman the UFO drops back to her car.
stages.title: Strangers, hunting & one-off feats — cleanup with a map

stages.hours_note: estimate; mostly waiting on confirmations, not grinding
steps: Check the three still-unconfirmed trophies one last time (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, Ten Pin): as of the round-3 re-check on 19 November 2026 no cited guide has a verified method for any of them, so there is nothing honest to chase yet — their entries collect what each source actually says, guesses labelled as guesses.
If a method has been confirmed since, those three are quick one-off feats; do them now, in free-roam, with the chapter saves from stage 1 as insurance.
When the 54th trophy lands, Vice Got a Price! pops on its own. Nothing here needs online play, DLC or a difficulty setting.
stages.title: Platinum mop-up — the three open questions, then the crown

title: Roadmap to the platinum — Vice Got a Price!
total_estimate_note: Estimate only: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and estimates about 200 hours to the platinum — story 60–80 hours, the 100% checklist about 100 hours, and Strangers & Freaks plus cleanup about 10 hours. The seven stages below split that same 200-hour estimate by the kind of work, so the per-stage hours still add up to 200. Your time will vary.
warnings: THE ONE WARNING: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept her meditation (Positive Mental Attitude). It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy. Do it. This is the only possibly-missable step in the whole run, and the Missable watch view exists for it.

There is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free-roam continues after the story and every trophy except possibly the Chapter 1 meditation stays earnable. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots; PowerPyx recommends 10 saves for chapter starts and ends) so a missed step never costs a full replay. Keep one prologue save too: Bad Luck, I Guess is unconfirmed, but two guides suspect a link to the prologue's Payday Loans store.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run (PowerPyx, GTABase). Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.

There are no difficulty settings, no mission gold medals and no online trophies. One playthrough is enough. Three trophies still have no confirmed method in any cited guide (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, Ten Pin) — do not chase guesses for them; their entries say so plainly and the mop-up stage parks them last.
